blurb.en: Aḥmad Shāh Durrānī's victory over the Marāṭhās, 14 January 1761, which ended their northern sway for a decade.
blurb.hi: 14 जनवरी 1761 को मराठों पर अहमद शाह दुर्रानी की विजय, जिसने उनके उत्तरी प्रभाव को एक दशक के लिए समाप्त किया।

reading: arriving at the town of Panipat, encamped there.

page.en: H. M. Elliot and John Dowson, The History of India as told by its own Historians (1877), p. 148
page.hi: H. M. Elliot and John Dowson, The History of India as told by its own Historians (1877), पृ. 148
